transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I just don’t care about my painting or the garden anymore, and the things I used to look forward to feel like a burden. It's like all the joy has just been drained out of the things that used to make me happy.
How long have you been feeling this way, and have you experienced similar periods of low mood or lack of interest in the past?

This heavy, low feeling has been hanging over me for about three months now, ever since I crashed after that busy spell in the spring. I’ve never experienced anything like this in the past; it is a completely new pattern for me.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your sleep patterns, appetite, or energy levels during these past three months?

My energy is just completely gone, and I feel bone-tired even if I lie down all day. I also have no appetite at all anymore and have to remind myself to eat, so my clothes have started hanging quite loose on me. It all just feels like such a chore.
Have you noticed that your thoughts or movements have slowed down significantly, or do you find it difficult to concentrate on even simple daily tasks?

Yes, most of the time now I shuffle around the house like I’m walking through molasses. When I try to do simple things like organize my husband's medications or schedule an appointment, my mind just goes blank or spins so much that I can't make a decision. It has made it incredibly hard to concentrate on anything.
Do you feel that you are currently experiencing any physical symptoms of extreme agitation, or conversely, a complete inability to experience any pleasure or respond to positive events at all?

No, I don't feel physically agitated right now—it is actually the opposite, as I feel completely slowed down like I'm walking through molasses. But I absolutely feel that total lack of pleasure, and I walk right past my easel and the garden and feel nothing at all. I just sit in my chair and let the hours go by because the things I used to love don't bring me any joy anymore.
Do you feel that you are currently experiencing any physical symptoms like a distinct loss of emotional reactivity, where even good news would fail to make you feel any better at all?

I'm not really sure about that, as I haven't really thought about whether good news would make me feel any better. I just feel very flat all the time now and have completely lost interest in my painting and my garden.
If something truly wonderful or unexpected happened right now, do you think you would be able to feel happy or react positively, even for a brief moment?

No, I don't think I could feel anything at all right now because this numbness is just too deep. Even if something wonderful happened, it feels like it would be too heavy and distant for me to muster up any real excitement. I just feel completely empty, and nothing seems to break through it.

latest_inference.note: The patient reports a significant duration of symptoms (three months), marked psychomotor retardation ('walking through molasses'), significant appetite loss with weight loss, and an inability to experience pleasure (anhedonia) even in response to hypothetical positive stimuli. The presence of 'somatic syndrome' features (anhedonia, lack of emotional reactivity, psychomotor retardation) alongside severe functional impairment suggests a diagnosis of a severe depressive episode without psychotic symptoms, narrowing the candidates from F32.1 (moderate) to F32.2 (severe).
